SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE, WRITER, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM NOTICE
PIN_YN= 'N'
and ( title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or writer like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or cast(notice_id as varchar2(100)) like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND CREATED_AT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND CREATED_AT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')+1
ORDER BY NOTICE_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE, WRITER, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, PIN_YN AS pinYn FROM NOTICE WHERE PIN_YN= 'Y' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC fetch first 3 rows only
SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, PIN_YN AS pinYn FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, WRITER = #{writer}, PIN_YN = #{pinYn}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: select r.reply_id as replyId, r.notice_id as noticeId, r.webuser_id as webuserId, r.parent_reply_id as parentReplyId, u.webuser_name as webuserName, r.content, r.created_at as createdAt from notice_reply r join webuser u on r.webuser_id = u.webuser_id where r.notice_id = #{noticeId} order by r.created_at asc
mapper.insert: insert into notice_reply (reply_id, notice_id, webuser_id, content, parent_reply_id) values (notice_reply_seq.nextval, #{noticeId}, #{webuserId}, #{content}, #{parentReplyId, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: update notice_reply set content = #{content} where reply_id = #{replyId}
